progression.narrative: The performance opens on F3 and dwells most on Ak in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:18.2) introduces Dk, centred on C. Phrase 5 (0:45.9) introduces G, Ab, centred on F. The line peaks at Ab4 (429.4 Hz) at 0:53.9. It closes on the tonic (Dk4 → F4 → G4 → Ab4 → G4 → G4).
